text:
```yaml
name: Labeler

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      taskId:
        description: 'ID of the task to label'
        required: true
        default: ''

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run labeler action
        uses: ./.github/actions/labeler
        with:
          taskId: ${{ github.event.inputs.taskId }}
```
